world.title: Veyr: The Tidelock Chronicle
world.premise: When the five Resonances fall out of sequence, expeditions must decide which histories a damaged world will carry forward.
world.cosmology: Ember, brine, gale, root, and veil are living habits of becoming. Their temporary agreements make magic possible, and every forced agreement leaves a witnessable cost.

magicAxioms.statement: A working must name the resonance it asks to change.
magicAxioms.cost: The practitioner becomes easier for that resonance to read.
magicAxioms.observableSign: A visible or audible trace persists after the working.
magicAxioms.prohibitedShortcut: No working may claim to be without an affinity or a witness.

magicAxioms.statement: A working may transfer a burden but cannot eliminate it.
magicAxioms.cost: Someone, somewhere, must carry the displaced consequence.
magicAxioms.observableSign: A memory, debt, wound, route change, or regional condition records the transfer.
magicAxioms.prohibitedShortcut: No effect may resolve a pressure by deleting its cost from the chronicle.

regions.name: Hushmere
regions.surfaceConflict: A drowned observatory speaks through reed bells and calls for names no one wants to remember.
regions.lastingQuestion: Who has the right to name a collective loss?

regions.name: The Cinder Spine
regions.surfaceConflict: A fuel-less kiln produces tools from remembered disasters.
regions.unlockCondition: Discover an open route during rising or crest.
regions.lastingQuestion: Can a tool be ethical if its origin is a wound?

factions.name: Keepers of the Last Lantern
factions.credo: What is witnessed may be mourned; what is hidden will return hungry.
factions.publicNeed: Guides are needed to reach Hushmere's sealed observatory.
factions.concealedCost: Every archive witness becomes bound to an unspeakable memory.

factions.name: Ashwright Compact
factions.credo: A made thing deserves a maker who accepts its consequences.
factions.publicNeed: Brine-glass is needed to quiet the eastern kiln.
factions.concealedCost: Each crafted tool remembers the disaster from which it was made.

progressionPaths.gate: Open the reed-bell route during a rising or crest phase.
progressionPaths.fictionalRationale: The observatory's floodwater briefly exposes the rope-forges' buried bridge.
